name: Nordkraft Slimbook Pro
description: The Nordkraft Slimbook Pro. A dependable laptops pick with a clean, no-nonsense design and the everyday features you actually use.

specs.inTheBox: Slimbook, 65W USB-C adapter, Quick-start guide, Power cord, Warranty card

reviews.author: Yusuf S.
reviews.title: Poor finish
reviews.body: Arrived with a scratch on the casing. Support were polite but slow to respond. Expected more from Nordkraft. Hoping the replacement is better.

reviews.author: Lakshmi P.
reviews.title: Worth every rupee
reviews.body: Bought this after returning two other brands. Build quality is genuinely good for the price. Second Nordkraft product I own and both have lasted. Would buy the same one again.

reviews.author: Meera R.
reviews.title: Solid, boring, reliable
reviews.body: Bought this after returning two other brands. Nothing has rattled loose or started creaking yet. Nordkraft seem to have got this one right. Happy to recommend it.

reviews.author: Yusuf H.
reviews.title: Would buy again
reviews.body: Replaced a five-year-old unit with this. It does the one job it advertises and does it well. Second Nordkraft product I own and both have lasted. No regrets.

reviews.author: Pooja J.
reviews.title: Fine for the price
reviews.body: Took a while to get used to this one. Slightly heavier in hand than the listing suggests. Packaging was fine, the manual less so. Still, I am keeping it.

reviews.author: Imran C.
reviews.title: Better than expected
reviews.body: Picked it up on a whim and it has earned its place. It does the one job it advertises and does it well. Nordkraft seem to have got this one right. No regrets.
